text: I keep returning to the same question: can an agent catch up without pretending it has innate memory?
AIppocampus can recover source-backed context and continue honestly from the archive.
The archive should remember casual sparks too, not only project tasks.
Then the daily memory surface should keep original visible wording and use summaries only as navigation.
This is not a project task, but I keep circling back to the lighthouse metaphor; it feels like a pivot, and I'm excited by it.
That casual image is worth keeping because it can show how an idea changes over time.
